decision: Selected the area centroid of the 'Sonstiges Sondergebiet Rechenzentrum' (SO, legend item 1.4.2) as drawn in the in-force Bebauungsplan GI 05/23 'Katzenfeld', after registering the plan sheet to the official basemap.de raster (BKG) with two building control features, as the project locator.

reference_map.request: basemap.de WMS GetMap, layer de_basemapde_web_raster_grau, CRS EPSG:25832, BBOX 475500,5605300,476300,5606100, 3150 x 3150 px (0.253968 m per pixel)

selected_properties.plan: Bebauungsplan GI 05/23 'Katzenfeld', Universitätsstadt Gießen, scale 1:1000, north arrow vertical; raster sheet 4183.2 x 2323.44 pt, rendered with pdftoppm at 100 dpi (1 px = 0.254 m at plan scale)
selected_properties.zone: Sonstiges Sondergebiet SO 'Rechenzentrum' (§ 11 BauNVO), GRZ 0.8, Baumassenzahl 10, abweichende Bauweise
selected_properties.zone_area_note: Orange legend-1.4.2 pixels classified, closed by 6 px and hole-filled; the largest component (918,749 px at 0.0645 m2) agrees with the Begründung's 5.94 ha Sondergebiet.

registration.model: translation with the plan's stated scale (1:1000) and north-up orientation held fixed; base_px = a + s*plan_px, s = 0.254 / 0.253968 = 1.000126
registration.transform_utm32: E = 475622.788 + 0.254000 * x ; N = 5606009.838 - 0.254000 * y (x, y = plan pixel indices at 100 dpi, pixel centres)

control_points.feature: round building (house number 29) in the plan's Gemeinbedarf area: centre of the plan's drawn inner circle vs centre of the basemap ring building's inner edge
control_points.fit: least-squares circle fits, plan radius 39.57 px (10.05 m), basemap radius 40.50 px (10.29 m)

control_points.feature: existing combined heat and power (KWK) building in the Versorgungsfläche: centroid of the plan's grey building footprint (206 m2) vs centroid of the basemap building (215 m2)

independent_checks: Telekom building at Krofdorfer Straße 200 (plan outline next to the 'T' Versorgungsfläche): the basemap building coincides with the plan outline in a blended overlay at 200 dpi after applying the fitted translation.
Free-scale check: the control-point separation is 458.88 m on the plan and 458.89 m on the basemap; the bearing differs by 0.06 degrees, so neither scale nor rotation needed fitting.
registration.rejected_attempts: A global FFT correlation of plan linework against basemap linework gave unstable peaks (labels and hatching dominate) and was not used.

identity_bridge: The plan's title block names Bebauungsplan Nr. GI 05/23, Gebiet 'Katzenfeld', Universitätsstadt Gießen; the Verfahrensvermerke record the Satzungsbeschluss of the Stadtverordnetenversammlung on 27.08.2026 and Ausfertigung on 02.10.2026.
Legend item 1.4.2 identifies the orange zone as 'Sonstige Sondergebiete hier: Rechenzentrum (§ 11 BauNVO)'; Textliche Festsetzung 1.2.1 restricts it to a data centre with its ancillary facilities.

The city's notice signed 02.10.2026 and listed on 05.10.2026 puts B-Plan GI 05/23 'Katzenfeld' into force; the zusammenfassende Erklärung and Begründung describe the roughly 6 ha Sondergebiet for a data centre of about 65 MW nominal power prepared with Revikon.

excluded_coordinates.kind: centroid of the whole 16.6 ha plan area (Geltungsbereich)
excluded_coordinates.reason: The plan area also contains a 6 ha Gewerbegebiet, a Versorgungsfläche, public green, compensation areas and a Gemeinbedarf area, so its centroid would not locate the data-centre zone.

excluded_coordinates.kind: street address 'Krofdorfer Str. 200' shown by third-party listings
excluded_coordinates.reason: Not from a primary source; in the plan, house number 200 is the existing Telekom building in a Versorgungsfläche outside the data-centre zone.
Adjacent substation north of the plan area; grid context only.
